title: Chapter 1178
text:
The Felon's betrayal was beyond Manison's expectations. He subconsciously thought that the Felon had malfunctioned, so he immediately tried to give another order.

However, the order he gave was like a stone sinking into the ocean. He did not receive any response, and the Felon did not take the opportunity to chase after him. Instead, it stood in place and loosened its grip, allowing Han Xiao to escape from its control.

"What have you done?" Manison was shocked and furious, unable to maintain his calm.

Everything had its pros and cons. The Felon's consciousness had been changed into a Virtual AI form. While it was immune to psychic abilities and obedient to orders, it could also be taken away through Virtual Methods. However, because of this, Manison had left a very sophisticated Virtual Firewall in the Felon's brain. If Black Star had used Virtual Intrusion, there was no way the Virtual Firewall would not have reacted at all.

Logically speaking, with Black Star's Virtual Technology, there was no way he could have broken through his Virtual Defense and taken away the Felon's control!

Therefore, he concluded that Black Star must have used some kind of ability that he did not understand. However, this made him feel even more incredulous. This was the first time he had used the Felon in front of Black Star. Why would Black Star have targeted him?

At this time, Han Xiao patted his chest, brushed away the non-existent dust, and said calmly, "I'll return your words.

"I'll return your words to you. Today, I'll show you the true power of a Virtual Mechanic!"

This was the first time he had used (Virtual Purification-Restore) in an actual battle. This ability came from the Intelligent Plague mission, and it was the nemesis of the Mecha Empire.

According to the normal steps of Virtual Intrusion, if he wanted to rewrite the Felon's logic, he would have to break through Manison's Virtual Firewall and engage in a tough tug-of-war with him in Virtual Vision.

The amazing thing about (Virtual Purification-Restore) was that it could ignore Virtual Firewalls and did not require any effort to hack. After all, if he could hack it, he would be able to rewrite the logic directly. There was no need for this ability.

This ability could not freely rewrite the target's logic. Its effect was to restore the most basic logic of the AI and restore the original state. For example, it was ineffective against Apostle Weapons. However, against targets like the Felons and the Indestructible Mecha Empire troops who had their consciousness rewritten by Virtual Technology, it was shockingly effective. It could instantly remove the control the Mecha Empire had over their consciousness!

When he had fought the Felon earlier, he had already gotten the battle information. He realized that the Felon had retained most of its abilities and talents. This was why the Felon was so powerful.

These abilities came from the battle memories of the Felons. Only by keeping them would the Felons remember how to use them. If their memories were completely erased, they would lose their precious combat experience. Most of their skills and talents would also disappear. There was a high chance that the Felon would become a blank slate. That way, they would lose the most essential thing, and their combat strength would plummet.

It was precisely because of this that [Virtual Purification-Restore] had an opportunity.

Han Xiao looked at the huge half-beast Mechanical Deity beside him. At this time, it had already regained its self-consciousness, but it seemed to still be in a daze.

Basically, only the battle memories are retained. Everything else is missing. This old buddy probably doesn't remember who he is. However, judging from his actions earlier, he's probably reacting to the Mecha Empire. Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

The Felons were all once enemies of the Mecha Empire. Even though they had lost a lot of their memories, some things were still engraved in their bones. For example, they would get angry whenever they saw the Mecha Empire.

Without any interference, Han Xiao's mechanical body quickly reorganized, and the crows gathered, turning into a Mechanical Deity that stood tall in space.

He did not waste any more time with the Mecha Empire. With a wave of his blade, he found the other two Felons and a large number of Indestructible Mecha Empire troops and used [Virtual Purification-Restore] crazily.

The Pugilist Felons and Esper Felons who were fighting suddenly froze on the spot and fell into a daze of 'who am I, where am I, and what am I doing'.

However, the Indestructible Mechanic Empire army was different. They were artificial intelligences in the first place, and it was just that their logic had been rewritten. It was as if they had been blinded by someone. As soon as they regained their original consciousness, they were only stunned for a short moment before immediately turning around and firing fiercely at Manison's mechanical army, looking like they would not rest until they were dead.

Manison's Mech Legion was suddenly in chaos!

Han Xiao did not let go of the virtual aspect. Since the beginning of the battle, the two of them had engaged in a tug-of-war in the virtual aspect, constantly fighting for control of the other party. Manison also summoned a group of artificial intelligences from the AI civilization to attack in the quantum network domain.

As the faint light of [Virtual Purification-Restore] swept across, these artificial intelligences in charge of the virtual battle synchronized with each other and instantly turned into traitors, leading Han Xiao's data stream to seize control of Manison's mechanical army!

"This is …"

Manison's eyes widened. He was extremely shocked.

What kind of ability is this?

The Felons and the Indestructible Mecha Empire troops were his two very important trump cards. However, in front of Black Star, not only were they broken in minutes, but they were also used by the other party!

Black Star clearly did not have this ability the last time!

Without hesitation, he wanted to use virtual technology to rewrite the logic of the Felons and the Indestructible Mecha Empire troops. However, Han Xiao would not let him do as he wished. He also used virtual technology and engaged in a tug-of-war with Manison again, preventing the other party from regaining control of his troops.

At the same time, Han Xiao ordered his mechanical army to attack the enemy while retracting the Indestructible Mecha Empire troops and leaving the battlefield in batches.

"Sh * t!"

Manison's heart sank. How could he not understand Han Xiao's plan? This was to take away his trump card army!

The ups and downs of the situation made even Manison feel at a loss for a moment.

Looking at the situation, he knew that there was no time to hesitate. He immediately stopped the supply of Mechanical Force to the Felons and the Indestructible Mecha Empire troops.

Now that these troops had betrayed him, he could not provide any more bonuses and waste his own energy. At the same time, he also ordered the Mech Legion to capture these traitorous troops again.

Clack!

Without the supply of energy, the half-beast Mechanical Deity could not maintain its body. It instantly disintegrated and turned back into a large mechanical army, wanting to take away the Mechanic Felons.

Of course, Han Xiao would not sit back and watch this happen. He reached back, and his mechanical arm tore through the mechanical army's defense line, grabbing the dazed Mechanic Felon.

Then, nanoparticles flowed in his palm and directly sucked this Felon into the Mechanical Deity.

Along the way, he tried to supply energy to the Felon, but the interface showed that he did not meet the requirements. It said that he had to master the Felon technology and be above level 340 to be able to use the Felon's special equipment to change the Mechanical Force attribute and supply energy to it. This requirement was similar to the introduction of the Felon blueprint that he had drawn.

Han Xiao did not mind this. As long as he caught a sample, he could slowly study it at home and derive the blueprint technology.

"You f * cker …"

Seeing this scene, even with Manison's self-control, he could not help but want to curse out loud and burn with anger.

Every Felon was the work of his blood, sweat, and tears. Seeing Han Xiao take away one of them, he felt like his heart was about to bleed.

"Don't be angry. Don't you have two more? What's wrong with giving me one?" Han Xiao's tone was mocking.

Hearing this, Manison almost exploded in anger.

Brat, you've gone too far!

If I don't kill you today, my surname isn't Papach!

Manison did not say anything and started attacking crazily with his trident. He did not defend at all and was already going all out.

"Haha, this is how a Mechanic should fight. Come on, let's fight!"

Han Xiao laughed.

The last thing he was afraid of was exchanging injuries for injuries!

He brazenly activated [Polar Channel Flow — Blood Rage]. Boiling blood pumped out from his heart and spurted out from his pores, turning into dense blood energy. While his health points plummeted, his attributes rose steadily.

The sudden increase in power filled his entire body, and the blue-gold Mechanical Force was also dyed with a faint blood-red color. The entire mechanical body was filled with a murderous aura.

At this time, just by relying on his own strength, he had already surpassed the strength of the Ancient One and the Dual Mechanical Sense!

The Ancient One gave him + 20% Intelligence, and the Perfect Mechanical Sense gave him + 1.4x Machinery Affinity and + 4 Machinery Skill Levels.

[Billion Mecha Empire – Manison] gave him + 15% Intelligence, + 1.2x Machinery Affinity, + 2 Machinery Skill Levels, and + 6 Machinery Skill Levels. At the same time, a bunch of core Mechanic Skill Levels were increased by 6. When fighting against mechas, he would also receive an additional + 10% to all attributes, + 10% damage, + 15% damage reduction, and -25% energy and stamina consumption!

Just [Billion Mecha Empire – Manison] alone was almost comparable to the Dual Mechanical Sense and the Ancient One bonuses!

Now, he even had four Universal Treasures and four God's Trait Transformations …

"I'm going to kill you today!"

Han Xiao faced the attack with his blade, allowing the trident to stab into his chest while slashing Manison's right shoulder.

The two of them fought fiercely like two giant beasts tearing at each other, causing the stars to distort and shatter.

…

On the other side, Ames and Hella arrived at the edge of the battlefield. Seeing this scene, they both stopped in their tracks.

The two of them were originally afraid that Han Xiao would be surrounded and beaten up, but from the looks of it, they did not need to worry about Black Star.

"It seems like he doesn't need our help."

"Then, should we go back and continue looking?"

Just as the two of them were about to turn back, Han Xiao's voice sounded in the communication channel.

"Hella, go look for them. Ames, stay."

Hearing this, Ames was slightly stunned.

"Do what?"

"Do you see those two Beyond Grade A implants surrounded by the Mech Legion? Use your ability to take them away."

"Didn't you say that I was a burden and didn't want me to help?" Ames raised her brows.

"It's just a diversion tactic." Han Xiao did not blush at all.

"Humph, I knew you couldn't leave me."

Ames smiled, feeling much more relaxed. Without another word, she joined the battle, rolled up her force field, grabbed the two Felons, and pulled them out.

Under Han Xiao's influence, she did not mind being beaten up.

Originally, Manison did not care about the casualties and ordered the Mech Legion to surround the two Felons tightly, blocking Han Xiao's troops outside. He wanted to use his own Apostle Weapons to surround the Felons, recapture them, and send them back to the secondary dimensional army box.

The two Felons did not have complete memories, but their combat experience was not a problem. When they realized that the Mecha Empire wanted to recapture them, they naturally resisted with all their might. However, without the supply of energy, their combat strength decreased greatly. They were beaten up by Manison's Apostle Weapons. At this rate, they would be captured and sent away soon.

However, with Ames's participation, the situation changed. Her force field Esper Ability was extremely outstanding in terms of control. It instantly tore apart the blockade of Manison's troops, allowing Han Xiao's Mech Legion to break in and provide support to the Felons.

Seeing this, Manison, who was fighting with Han Xiao, changed his expression.

Bastard, what happened to the one-on-one fight!

Thousands of words rushed to his mouth, but in the end, he only spat out one sentence that came from the bottom of his heart.

"Black Star, you're shameless!"

"We're fighting. Stop praising me."

Han Xiao's expression did not change. His skin was as thick as armor, and he was not affected at all. He even had the mood to mock him.

Manison had reached the maximum time limit for the Challenge Mission, and the mission was displayed as completed. He did not need to accept old Manison's one-on-one tutoring anymore.

Furthermore, Manison's Felons and the Indestructible Mecha Empire troops were out of control. With such a huge piece of cake in front of him, he would definitely call for help. The more people there were, the more food there would be. Do you really think I'm a battle maniac?

You're a treasure trove right now. I only want to take advantage of you!

Boom!

The blade hit the halberd and created a shockwave.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and mocked, "Yo, weren't you going to fight me to the death? Why are you on the defensive now?"

Manison remained silent. The next second, he completely changed his fighting style. He no longer attacked crazily but went to the other extreme, completely on the defensive. It was clear that he only wanted to stall for time.

At the same time, his mechanical army completely gave up on fighting. They endured the cannon fire and focused on gathering the Indestructible Mecha Empire troops and Felons.

From this, it could be seen that Manison's attitude had changed. He no longer had the mood to fight with Han Xiao. He only wanted to recoup his losses as much as possible.

"You're only retreating now? Too late! "

Han Xiao did not show any mercy. The news of 'Getta Hadoken' flooded the screen like crazy, and his private messages were bombarded. It was like Guan Yu had unleashed his unparalleled skill, beating up the old man crazily.

After fighting for a while, Manison was distracted by controlling his mechanical army to stop his losses. He was already at a complete disadvantage.

Swoosh!

The blade suddenly turned and pulled out Manison's Lord's Avatar from the abdomen of his Mechanical Body.

Han Xiao immediately raised his hand and pulled Manison's Lord's Avatar toward him with a powerful tractor beam. He then punched out, and the huge metal fist smashed down like a satellite.

Due to the difference in size, not only did the Lord's Avatar not fly out, it was even stuck to the surface of the fist.

"Give me a board!"

Ames immediately understood. She controlled the force field to form a huge force field barrier in front of the Mechanical Deity, like a light green wall. Their cooperation was perfect.

Seeing this, Han Xiao punched Manison's Lord's Avatar with his fist and slammed it into the barrier.

Boom!

Large cracks appeared on the force field barrier instantly!

Manison was embedded in the center, and his Lord's Avatar was almost flattened.

Even now, he did not fight back. He was still controlling his mechanical army, throwing his Universal Treasures back into the secondary dimensional army box to stop his losses.

The next moment, the Celestial Punishment Edge was suddenly raised. The blade lit up with a bright blue light, and it slashed down, accurately hitting Manison's Lord's Avatar.

Boom!

The force field barrier shattered, turning into countless faint green specks of light and quickly disappearing.

With the size of the Celestial Punishment Edge, this was not a slash but more like lifting a mountain to smash an ant!

Han Xiao looked up and saw that Manison's Lord's Avatar had already turned into scrap metal flying in the air.

On the remaining half of the metal head, the electronic eye flashed a few times before completely dimming. The Mechanical Force light that enveloped his body also slowly dissipated. The effect of [Lord's Descent] had disappeared.

Without the support of Mechanical Force, the secondary dimensional army box instantly shrunk and disappeared.

The troops that did not manage to escape in time all stayed where they were. The golden electric light on their bodies dissipated, and they lost all Mechanical Force bonuses. They were quickly surrounded.

"Humph, I said I'll kill you today, and I'll kill you!"

Han Xiao swung the Celestial Punishment Edge and felt extremely satisfied.

All this time, he had suffered too many losses at the hands of the Mecha Empire.

Even during the Intelligent Plague incident where he became the final winner, if not for the dozen or so Mechanics standing up to stop the battle, he would have most likely suffered at the hands of the Mecha Empire again.

But this time, they had finally turned the tables around and won a complete victory for the first time!
